name: language-coach
description: Host-agnostic speaking coach. Practice stays in the target language; corrections and the wrap-up use the learner's explanation language. Optional Codex discovery file — other agents load skills/language-coach/SKILL.md and can ignore this manifest.

interface.shortDescription: Spoken practice with selective correction, review, and shadowing.
interface.longDescription: A reusable speaking-coach skill. It holds a patient conversation in the learner's chosen language variant, corrects only what matters, saves vocabulary on request, and ends with a six-part review plus sentence-by-sentence shadowing. Real-time voice comes from the host app.
defaultPrompt: 我们开始今天的口语练习。目标是美式英语。
